criteria.description: A codex command is read/inspection only when every operator-split segment leads with a read command, no write redirection, no mutating op; else scanned.
criteria.evidence: TestClassifyCodexReadCommand: compound `git diff && go build`, substitution `cat $(rm x)`/`<(...)`, redirection, find -delete, git --ext-diff/--output, rg --pre, env-prefix, dangling operator all -> not read. Hardened over 9 adversarial Codex rounds.
criteria.verified_by: kent (maintainer) via Claude orchestration + adversarial Codex review
criteria.notes: Verified via co-located test-first tests + frozen-corpus diff; per-WP Codex review.
